articles.summary: Across many conversations with support teams, two buyers in unrelated industries picked the same first AI use case: the roughly one-third of tickets that are about money. Here is why, in their words.
articles.title: Which customer service tickets should you automate first?

articles.summary: Nobody we talk to switches an AI agent on overnight. Support leaders design their own on-ramp, keep supervision short, and set one question the test has to answer.
articles.title: Taking a customer-service AI agent live

articles.summary: Every support leader we talk to arrives with a number for how much AI is allowed to automate. The numbers range from 30% to 90%, and what sets them is rarely the AI.
articles.title: How much customer service can AI automate?
